gold_sql:
WITH p1 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.02759 38.893662)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.02759 38.893662)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
),
p2 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.99957 40.73204)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.99957 40.73204)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN p1.elev > p2.elev THEN 'Sushi Nakazawa, Washington, DC'
    WHEN p2.elev > p1.elev THEN 'Blue Hill, New York, NY'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS higher_poi,
  p1.elev AS poi1_elevation_m,
  p2.elev AS poi2_elevation_m
FROM p1, p2;

WITH points_of_interest AS (
  SELECT 
    '[3]' AS id,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-77.02759, 38.893662), 4326)::geography AS geom,
    'Sushi Nakazawa, Washington, DC' AS name
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    '[4]' AS id,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-73.99957, 40.73204), 4326)::geography AS geom,
    'Blue Hill, New York, NY' AS name
)
SELECT 
  p.name,
  ROUND(ST_Value(r.rast, ST_Transform(p.geom::geometry, 4326))::numeric, 2) AS elevation
FROM 
  points_of_interest p
  JOIN public.dem_us r ON ST_Intersects(ST_Transform(p.geom::geometry, 4326), r.rast)
ORDER BY 
  elevation DESC
LIMIT 1;
